results.title: Sonam Ghosh Selected for India's U-17 Squad in AFC Women's Asian Cup Qualifiers
results.description: Sonam Ghosh, a talented goalkeeper from Zinc Football Academy, has been selected for India's U-17 squad for the AFC U-17 Women’s Asian Cup Qualifiers in 2027. At just 15 years old, her inclusion in the team marks a significant achievement in her young career. The Young Tigresses will compete in Group E, starting their campaign against Iraq on October 5. Sonam's journey reflects the success of ZFA's girls' program, which has been instrumental in nurturing young talent. Her story serves as an inspiration for aspiring female footballers across the nation.
